title: NASA asteroid sheet: 3 Juno diameter 234 km, ~mass 20,000×10^15 kg
summary: The sheet's selected-asteroid row for Juno prints diameter 234 km and an approximate mass 20,000 × 10^15 kg.
body: The Asteroid Fact Sheet row for 3 Juno prints diameter 234 km, mass about 20,000 × 10^15 kg, rotation period 7.210 hrs, orbital period 4.36 yrs, spectral class S, semi-major axis 2.670 AU, eccentricity 0.2563, and inclination 12.99 deg. Orbit values for epoch JD 2457400.5 (2016-01-13). Most of the values for mass and many of the diameter values are only rough estimates. The mass column header on the sheet is "~Mass", which marks the mass as approximate. The sheet's note says Juno is the 3rd asteroid discovered, by K. Harding in 1804. This card does not promote the row to a precision measurement.
